examples_lsys_day_03

Consider the L system defined by the following start and replacement rules:

  • Start: X
  • Rules:
    C > GG
    G > ZC
    X > XG
    Z > ZXC

After 5 iterations, what string is developed? I'd recommend using this tool.

Use the tool. The correct answer is:

XGZCZXCGGZXCXGGGZCZCZXCXGGGXGZCZCZCZXCGGZXCGG
